words.vi: Một điều gì đó rất dễ dàng
words.ex: The exam was a piece of cake.

words.vi: Càng nhiều người tham gia thì càng tốt
words.en: The more people involved, the better
words.ex: Bring your friends to the party – the more the merrier.

words.w: have your cake and eat it too
words.vi: Muốn hai thứ không tương thích cùng một lúc
words.en: To want two incompatible things at once
words.ex: You can't have your cake and eat it too.

words.vi: Một lợi ích bổ sung cho một cái gì đó đã tốt
words.en: An additional benefit to something already good
words.ex: Winning the prize was the icing on the cake.

words.w: too many cooks spoil the broth
words.vi: Quá nhiều người tham gia làm hỏng kết quả
words.en: Too many people involved ruins the outcome
words.ex: Let one person lead – too many cooks spoil the broth.

words.w: have a finger in every pie
words.vi: Được tham gia nhiều hoạt động
words.en: To be involved in many activities
words.ex: She has a finger in every pie at the company.

words.vi: Để cung cấp một cái gì đó có giá trị cho một tình huống
words.en: To offer something valuable to a situation
words.ex: What skills do you bring to the table?
The new sneakers are selling like hot cakes.

words.vi: Rất bình tĩnh, đặc biệt là dưới áp lực
words.ex: She stayed cool as a cucumber during the crisis.
We're in a bit of a pickle without the car keys.
Horror movies are not my cup of tea.

words.vi: Để khuyến khích ai đó làm điều gì đó nguy hiểm
words.en: To encourage someone to do something risky
words.ex: His friends egged him on to try the stunt.

words.w: have a lot on your plate
words.vi: Có nhiều việc phải giải quyết
words.en: To have many things to deal with
words.ex: I can't help right now – I have a lot on my plate.

words.vi: Trở nên rất phấn khích hoặc tức giận
words.en: To become very excited or angry
words.ex: The crowd went bananas when the team scored.
Use your noodle and figure out the answer.

words.w: the proof is in the pudding
words.vi: Giá trị thực được thể hiện bằng kết quả
words.en: The real value is shown by results
words.ex: He claims the product works, but the proof is in the pudding.

words.vi: Để làm điều gì đó thú vị hơn
words.ex: Let's spice things up with a new activity.

words.w: take something with a pinch of salt
words.vi: Không hoàn toàn tin vào điều gì đó
words.ex: Take his promises with a pinch of salt.
